title: Pin Rich Menu URI allowlists and clean up orphan menus on upload errors
context_summary: LINE Rich Menu provisioning creates menu IDs before uploading PNG content.
observation: Unpinned LIFF paths risked spoofing and failed PNG uploads could leave orphaned Rich Menus.
verified_action: Pin allowedLiffId and tenant clientCode subdomains, reject '..' segments, delete orphaned menus on failure, and target 2500x1686 PNG (<250 KB).
